decision: Decision 2026-10-13 (Louis): every AETC user becomes a MaHIS user. A username or system_id MaHIS already has gets _aetc appended (then _aetc2, ...); the renamed users are listed in log/aetc_migration/<tracking>-usernames-taken-<ts>.csv. No password (an admin sets one); AETC retired users stay retired; location_id = target_location_id; access to target_program_id; AETC roles that exist in MaHIS are copied. creator/changed_by/voided_by/orderer of every migrated row -> the AETC user's MaHIS user (users_lookup); the aetc_migration user owns the new accounts and stands in for AETC user ids that no longer exist. mappings[] below is reference only (audit_references).
